(27 July) |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2024 Primera Nacional|2024]] |nextseason= [[2026 Primera Nacional|2026]] }} The '''2025 Argentine Primera Nacional''', officially known as the '''Campeonato de Primera Nacional Sur Finanzas 2025''' for sponsorship purposes,{{cite web |url=https://www.afa.com.ar/Sitio/posts/se-realizo-el-sorteo-del-torneo-de-la-primera-nacional-2025 |title=Se realizó el sorteo del torneo de la Primera Nacional 2025 |trans-title=The draw for the 2025 Primera Nacional tournament was held |publisher=[[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] |language=es |date=20 December 2024 |access-date=27 December 2024}} was the 41st season of the [[Primera Nacional]], the second-tier competition of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine football]]. Thirty-six teams competed in the league, thirty-three of which took part in the [[2024 Primera Nacional|2024 season]], along with one team promoted from [[Torneo Federal A]] and two teams promoted from [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. The season began on 6 February and ended on 30 November 2025, and the fixture draw was held on 20 December 2024. [[Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza]] were the champions, winning their first title in the competition as well as achieving promotion to the [[AFA Liga Profesional de Fútbol]] after defeating [[Deportivo Madryn]] on penalties following a 1–1 draw after extra time in the championship final.{{cite web |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-ascenso/final-deportivo-madryn-gimnasia-mendoza-primer-ascenso_0_pg5AtThHAy.html |title=Histórico: con Rigamonti figura en los penales, Gimnasia de Mendoza ascendió a Primera |trans-title=Historical: with Rigamonti as the MVP in the penalty shootout, Gimnasia de Mendoza promoted to ''Primera'' |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=11 October 2025 |access-date=11 October 2025}} The other team that promoted to the top flight at the end of the season was [[Estudiantes de Río Cuarto]], who won the Torneo Reducido after defeating Deportivo Madryn in the finals by a 3–1 aggregate score.{{cite web |url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/estudiantes-de-rio-cuarto-ascendio-a-primera-historico-regreso-despues-de-40-anos/ |title=¡Inolvidable! Estudiantes de Río Cuarto ascendió a Primera: histórico regreso después de 40 años |trans-title=Unforgettable! Estudiantes de Río Cuarto promoted to ''Primera'': a historic return after 40 years |publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]] |language=es |date=30 November 2025 |access-date=30 November 2025}} ==Format== For this season, the competition was played under the same format as the previous season, with the thirty-six participating teams split into two zones of 18 teams, where they played against the other teams in their group twice: once at home and once away. However, since this season had two teams less than the previous one as no teams were relegated from [[2024 Argentine Primera División|Primera División]], no interzonal matches between rival teams were played, although rival sides were still paired together for the season draw and drawn into different zones. Both zone winners played a final match on neutral ground to decide the first promoted team to the top flight for the following season, while the teams placed from second to eighth place in each zone played a knockout tournament (''Torneo Reducido'') for the second promotion berth along with the loser of the final between the zone winners. Moreover, the playoff match between the sides placing second-from-bottom in each group was not played this season, and instead four teams were relegated to the third-tier leagues, those being the bottom two teams from each zone.{{cite web |title=Así será la Primera Nacional 2025: conocé las zonas y formato |trans-title=This is how the 2025 Primera Nacional will be: find out the zones and format |url=https://www.tycsports.com/primera-nacional/primera-nacional-2025-zonas-formato-participantes-ascensos-descensos-id625454.html |publisher=[[TyC Sports]] |language=es |date=21 December 2024 |access-date=27 December 2024}} Similar to previous seasons, fifteen Primera Nacional teams qualified for the [[2026 Copa Argentina]] through league performance, those being the top seven teams of each zone plus the best eighth-placed one.{{cite web |title=Primera Nacional: los 36 equipos confirmados y el fixture para 2025 |trans-title=Primera Nacional: the 36 confirmed teams and the fixture for 2025 |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ascenso/b-nacional/primera-nacional-2025-36-equipos-fixture-confirmado-zonas_0_LIp9IfZh90.html |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=21 December 2024 |access-date=27 December 2024}} ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2025 Primera Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
